extraction.title: PLA Glow
extraction.seoMetaDescription: PLA Glow stands out due to its incorporation of a unique additive: luminous powder. This variant retains the familiar qualities of traditional PLA, including easy printing, high quality, and exceptional overall mechanical properties. What sets PLA Glow apart is its distinctive feature—it glows in the dark. This makes it the optimal selection for crafting luminous nameplates, logos, jewelry, and various models that require a captivating glow effect.

features.title: Product Features
features.html:
• Unique Glow in Low Light Conditions
  • Comes with Basic Reusable Spool
  • Diameter: 1.75mm +/- 0.03mm

 

Cautions for Use
  • A Hardened Steel Nozzle is required when printing
  • Stainless Steel Nozzles NOT Compatible
  • 0.2 mm nozzles NOT Compatible
  • AMS 2 Pro, AMS HT & AMS Compatible, but can lead to faster wear
  • AMS lite NOT Compatible

answerBlocks.content: • Not compatible with Hotend with Stainless Steel Nozzle 0.2mm, and AMS lite.
• Utilizing AMS lite may result in high feed resistance and an increased risk of feed failure. Consider alternative methods such as pre-use drying for better outcomes.

• Dry before use to ensure the best print quality and consistent finish. Store in a dry environment after use. For more details, please refer to: Filament drying instructions on WIKI.
  • For opened filament, we recommend drying before use according to the wiki’s recommended temperature and time settings.

The model's luminous intensity diminishes over time, but exposure to ultraviolet or sunlight for a brief period (approximately 2 hours) can rejuvenate its glow. However, prolonged or frequent irradiation may expedite PLA aging.

• Please store the filament in a cool, dark, and dry environment away from direct sunlight and high temperatures.
  • Please keep filament and any broken fragments out of reach of infants, children, and pets to prevent swallowing or choking.
  • Please print this filament in a well-ventilated area, or install an effective air filtration or exhaust system.
  • As this filament is not food-grade, please avoid using finished prints for food storage or contact.

content_blocks.body_en: Unique Glow in Low Light Conditions

content_blocks.title_en: Unique Glow in Low Light Conditions
content_blocks.body_en: Bambu PLA Glow incorporates a distinct additive: luminous powder, which imparts a special property to printed objects, causing them to emit a captivating glow in the dark.
All printing parameters are embedded in RFID, which can be read through our AMS (Automatic Material System).

1.Accessory Compatibility
Not compatible with Hotend with Stainless Steel Nozzle 0.2mm, and AMS lite.
Utilizing AMS lite may result in high feed resistance and an increased risk of feed failure. Consider alternative methods such as pre-use drying for better outcomes.

2.Drying Recommendations
Dry before use to ensure the best print quality and consistent finish. Store in a dry environment after use. For more details, please refer to: Filament drying instructions on WIKI.
For opened filament, we recommend drying before use according to the wiki’s recommended temperature and time settings.

3. Appearance Change
The model's luminous intensity diminishes over time, but exposure to ultraviolet or sunlight for a brief period (approximately 2 hours) can rejuvenate its glow. However, prolonged or frequent irradiation may expedite PLA aging.

4.Safety Tips
Please store the filament in a cool, dark, and dry environment away from direct sunlight and high temperatures.
Please keep filament and any broken fragments out of reach of infants, children, and pets to prevent swallowing or choking.
Please print this filament in a well-ventilated area, or install an effective air filtration or exhaust system.
As this filament is not food-grade, please avoid using finished prints for food storage or contact.
